description: Registry of transcribed keyboard layouts maintained in this repository. Consulted before falling back to the OS-supplied XKB geometries. See README.md to contribute one.

layouts.name: Lenovo Calliope (space-saving full-size)
layouts.notes: Transcribed from the physical keycaps. Differs from pc104: Insert in the function row, ScrLk before PrtSc, Home/End on the number row, double-height Delete, an Fn key that emits nothing, and no right Super.

layouts.name: HP 15-f233wm (US)
layouts.notes: US model reference: compact function/navigation row, integrated number pad, stacked half-height arrows, no right Windows or Menu key. Physical confirmation pending.

osGeometries.description: XKB geometry names available from the OS at /usr/share/X11/xkb/geometry. Discovered when no library layout matches; the renderer uses the bundled stand-in file. Presence is checked at runtime, not assumed.
